concept_label: 两轮访谈间其他工作数量
source_label: How Many Other Jobs Have You Been Doing from Last IWR?
value_semantics: Count of other jobs held for at least one month between the prior and current interview.
mapping_status: official 2013 questionnaire and codebook item reviewed; candidate; route and analysis eligibility require survey-design review
questionnaire_review: 2013 FA006_w2 retrospective work-history path verified; item-level route retained. See audit/interwave_other_job_mapping_review_2026-10-17.md.
caveat: Excludes work held in the prior interview and work held at the current interview. If 0, the questionnaire skips to FA007; later duration/intensity/income items are structurally skipped, not zero.

concept_label: 两轮访谈间其他工作累计月份
source_label: How Many Months Were You Working on These Jobs?
value_semantics: Total number of months worked across the qualifying between-wave other jobs.
mapping_status: official 2013 questionnaire and codebook item reviewed; candidate; route and analysis eligibility require survey-design review
questionnaire_review: 2013 FA006_w2 retrospective work-history path verified; item-level route retained. See audit/interwave_other_job_mapping_review_2026-10-17.md.
caveat: Only asked after fa006_w2_5 is positive. Do not infer months from the interview interval or treat a routed skip as zero.

concept_label: 两轮访谈间其他工作每月平均工作周数
source_label: How Many Weeks Were You Working on Average Per Month on These Jobs?
value_semantics: Average weeks worked per month while doing the qualifying between-wave other jobs.
mapping_status: official 2013 questionnaire and codebook item reviewed; candidate; route and analysis eligibility require survey-design review
questionnaire_review: 2013 FA006_w2 retrospective work-history path verified; item-level route retained. See audit/interwave_other_job_mapping_review_2026-10-17.md.
caveat: Only asked after fa006_w2_5 is positive. This is not the count of weeks in the whole interview interval.

concept_label: 两轮访谈间其他工作每周平均工作天数
source_label: How Many Days Were You Working on Average Per Week on These Jobs?
value_semantics: Average days worked per week while doing the qualifying between-wave other jobs.
mapping_status: official 2013 questionnaire and codebook item reviewed; candidate; route and analysis eligibility require survey-design review
questionnaire_review: 2013 FA006_w2 retrospective work-history path verified; item-level route retained. See audit/interwave_other_job_mapping_review_2026-10-17.md.
caveat: Only asked after fa006_w2_5 is positive. Keep separate from the weeks-per-month and hours-per-day items; do not derive total hours without a reviewed rule.

concept_label: 两轮访谈间其他工作每天平均工作小时数
source_label: How Many Hours Were You Working on Average Per Day on These Jobs?
value_semantics: Average hours worked per day while doing the qualifying between-wave other jobs.
mapping_status: official 2013 questionnaire and codebook item reviewed; candidate; route and analysis eligibility require survey-design review
questionnaire_review: 2013 FA006_w2 retrospective work-history path verified; item-level route retained. See audit/interwave_other_job_mapping_review_2026-10-17.md.
caveat: Only asked after fa006_w2_5 is positive. Not a current-work or primary-job hours measure.

concept_label: 两轮访谈间其他工作月平均收入
source_label: Average Income You Earned Per Month from These Jobs
value_semantics: Average monthly earnings from the qualifying between-wave other jobs, with personal income tax and insurance payment excluded per the questionnaire wording.
mapping_status: official 2013 questionnaire and codebook item reviewed; candidate; route and analysis eligibility require survey-design review
questionnaire_review: 2013 FA006_w2 retrospective work-history path verified; item-level route retained. See audit/interwave_other_job_mapping_review_2026-10-17.md.
caveat: Only asked after fa006_w2_5 is positive. The questionnaire defines the reference work interval and excludes prior-wave and current jobs. Do not merge with current-job wages or 2018 secondary-job income.
